appDesc.message: Dubs subtitled videos in real time: local translation, voice synced with playback. 65+ languages.

autoPauseLabel.message: Auto-pause when the voice falls behind

hint.message: Play the video, then flip the switch: the voice follows the subtitles in your language. At 0%, only the dub is audible.

accountNoteNotLinked.message: Local dubbing stays free, unlimited and account-free.

accountNoteFree.message: Unlock context-aware translation and upcoming Pro features.

accountNoteProCanceled.message: Subscription active until the end of the period.

statusNoVideo.message: No video detected on this page.

statusSubsLoading.message: Subtitle track detected — play for a few seconds to load the lines.

statusNoSubs.message: This player does not expose its subtitles — dubbing is not possible on this video.

statusNoVoice.message: No voice installed for this language. On Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content.

statusLocalUnavailable.message: Local translation unavailable (strict mode on). Chrome may be downloading its model — retry in a moment.

statusSiteDisabled.message: Voxylio is disabled on this site (see Options).

statusNoComm.message: Cannot reach the page. Reload it (F5) and reopen this panel.

optProviderHint.message: Chrome's local translation always comes first. The keyless online fallback is an unofficial, best-effort service — a free DeepL key (500,000 characters/month) is more reliable.

optKeyStored.message: Keys stay on this device (storage.local) — never synced.

optKeyOk.message: Valid key — $USED$ / $LIMIT$ characters used this month.

optSitesHint.message: Voxylio stays completely inactive on these sites (no detection, no dubbing).

optBackupHint.message: The export never contains API keys.
